## Assigned Issue and scope

Link the Issue, dependency PRs and exact compatibility revisions where relevant.

## Changes and ownership

Identify source and interface changes, rights/provenance review and substantive AI assistance.

## Evidence

Record exact commands, source identity and observed PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT RUN or N/A. List local, hosted and private runtime evidence independently. Keep private evidence out of the PR.

## Handoff

Record unresolved defects, dependency/order constraints, and rollback or next action where applicable.
